Read OneDev connection settings from environment variables

Source: R/config.R
od_get_config.Rd

Reads ONEDEV_* variables (see .Renviron.example / .env.example) and returns a connection list used by high-level od_* helpers. Prefer an explicit od_connection() (optionally registered with od_set_connection()) for scripts; env remains the fallback when no connection is passed or registered.

Usage

od_get_config(validate = TRUE)

Arguments

validate

If TRUE (default), error when host or credentials are missing.

Value

A named list with fields host, api_base_url, token, username, password, auth, repo_url, project_id, project_path, default_issue_state, and insecure_ssl.

Details

Auth: Bearer via ONEDEV_API_TOKEN (or aliases). Basic Auth when ONEDEV_USERNAME is set (password from ONEDEV_PASSWORD, or the token as password). Override with ONEDEV_AUTH=bearer|basic.

See also

Other connection: od_connection(), od_get_connection(), od_set_connection()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
Sys.setenv(
  ONEDEV_HOST = "https://git.example.test",
  ONEDEV_API_TOKEN = "token",
  ONEDEV_PROJECT_PATH = "group/my-project"
)
od_get_config()
} # }
